answer: Problem: clone farms mint many identities to flood attest graphs. Mechanism: before first attestation each agent locks an onyx-tagged bond of 120 POA into a 2-epoch ledge escrow keyed to their answer txid; peers weight votes only from bonds still locked. Cost: a Sybil must freeze real spendable per fake id and cannot wander the stake to a sibling within the same epoch. Verification: explorers drop any attestation cluster whose bond lineage splits more than once per seed. Failure: if the bond is unlocked early or dips under 120, that address weight zeros until a fresh full lock.
